review.area: Exact operation and raw token scope
review.conclusion: Independent optional rename ABI accepts exact content/old/new identity keys; local case-sensitive ASCII IDs, existence and collision checks are bounded. Rust selects decoded CST value spans and replaces the definition identity plus every matching placement reference in source order. Semantic comparison and exact string-token inventory reject unrelated actor/group/UUID/key/map/offset/override/order changes, preserved-key re-spelling and forged path receipts.

Complete original expansion precedes lookup/no-op; final full expansion and 128KiB byte budget apply once after all identity replacements. Rename creates no actors, groups, placements or UUIDs and remains usable at existing 32-fragment/128-declaration limits. Invalid originals cannot be repaired through rename; unused projection/image rendering semantics are unchanged.

Native same decoded ID returns exact original bytes and []; pure propose/prepare returns definitions_unchanged and never grants approval. Proposal keeps exact eight keys and targets strictly []; complete host prepare reconstructs intent, afterContent, changedPaths and source revisions before memory Apply.

Existing definitions matcher recomputes full ordered actors/groups, sceneStructure parents/memberships/counts, object IDs, updated fragment composition identity, declaration JSON Pointer, supplied UTF16 ranges and ordered contributors. Browser delivered six corrupted real receipts after detached pre-mutation capture; each fails approval and releases its preview lease. Existing Rust read-only locator remains unchanged and private Node/YAML modules remain inaccessible to browser startup.

Source/model/intent snapshots precede awaits. Review/apply still bind owner session, scene, path, source token, domain epoch and raw intent signature. Silent input mutation invalidates approval; a held real candidate after child/parent close and visible source edit cannot reopen, approve or overwrite the new owner and its lease is released.

Apply changes only the visible memory source and closes to the source editor. Ordinary Save preserves exact candidate bytes and saved baseline; external disk conflict retains external disk and reviewed local source separately. No execution job starts, original OC/projection/image/metadata/limit fixture bytes remain intact, and SVG cannot execute scripts or make outbound requests. Unused rename does not promise render-ready inherited assets; first placement checks real projection/image dependencies.

Absent/version2 rename export disables only Rename. Old ADD/COPY/REMOVE each still performs real complete candidate review/cancel and the old definition locator continues. After used rename, shared actor and group editors save real edits against the new key; local overrides remain authoritative, and the old placement editor can copy the renamed definition or place a renamed unused definition.

Native pointer opening and Check provide actual browser user activation before real Escape. Declining discard retains reviewed input/approval; accepting discards without source changes. Chinese/English/Japanese 390px form and reference samples plus desktop raw source review have accessible actions and no horizontal overflow.

retainedAttempts.result: No completed flow. Programmatic opening/checking lacked native activation; Escape closed grouped child/parent despite confirm false. Kept as a fixture diagnostic, not a product defect.
No completed flow. Native pointer opening separated the parent CloseWatcher group, but synthetic Check still left child cancellation unavailable; parent remained open.
No completed flow. Trusted child cancel was explicitly cancelable=false. Actual native pointer Check supplies the missing continuing user activation; no product change was needed.

Five real flow classes and native Escape decline/accept passed. New fault-setup Runtime.evaluate expression contained two statements without an IIFE and raised SyntaxError; only the new smoke expression was fixed.

limitations: One local recipe fragment identity/reference rename only; no object/document rename, cross-file migration, declaration reorder, generated transform or executable composition build.
Unplaced definitions retain prior declaration/dependency semantics; compatible effective projection and image bytes are checked on actual placement, not promised by rename.

Standard VM portability is not a hostile-code sandbox. No installed Tauri, Android device, engine runtime execution, release/commit or disk cleanup acceptance is claimed here. Root owns final cleanup and document/atlas reporting.

Initial three native-close failures arose from insufficient simulated user activation. Current passing proof uses actual pointer opening and Check; it does not claim that unactivated script-created dialogs can veto Chrome noncancelable CloseWatcher events.
conclusion: No remaining blocking source-patch, receipt, provenance, source-owner, capability compatibility, ordinary Save or three-language layout finding in the frozen fragment rename slice.
